title: Smoke test: run caliptra_test against hw-model, verify RNG and one crypto op
description: Build and run caliptra_test with the hw-model backend. Verify at minimum: RNG returns bytes, SHA-384 empty-message KAT passes, AES-256-GCM round-trip passes. Document any firmware command ID mismatches between caliptra_port.h constants and actual Caliptra runtime firmware. Fix any issues found during smoke test.
